description: Native AI-BS DX12 Prop01 rendering, offscreen creator acceptance, collision proxy enclosure repair, and regression qualification

key_findings.collision_proxy_enclosure: Discovered that v03 collision proxies protruded through Prop01 visual shell (+0.910m prisms vs +0.8887m recessed cap; 0.315m radius vs 0.276m waist; 0.670m LCP box vs 0.4449m chamfers; 0.085m PCB vs 0.071m bevel). Applied grouped ContentSetField enclosure edit preserving exact 4 UUIDs, enclosing proxies inside 3D shell, passing Jolt character step-on and octagonal casing block.
key_findings.visual_handedness_mirroring: Forensically verified that Blender previews (Prop01_top.png, Prop01_quarter.png) read unmirrored from left to right, but exporting right-handed Blender (x,z,-y) into DirectX 12 left-handed world reflects silkscreen text horizontally across an axis. Documented transparently as a non-blocking visual caveat for future art re-cooks.
key_findings.material_model_scope: AIBSurf2 (opaque-albedo-emission-v2) binds mipmapped sRGB albedo + tint/emission; normal maps and metallic/roughness PBR textures remain outside AIBSurf2 shader scope.
key_findings.creator_workflow: Verified outliner selection, native DX12 offscreen viewport preview & Win32 click-pick via aibs_creator_viewport.exe --self-test (811,278 pixels, 0 debug errors), asset adoption & placement of repeated capacitor, deletion/Undo/Redo, hero movement/Undo/Redo/restoration, acknowledged saving, and clean separate-process reopen in fresh ContentView with 0 orphaned rows and exact parameter persistence.
